title: Evaluate text classification and word scores
description: You inspect test predictions and words associated with spam or ham.

steps.description: You fit the vectorizer on training text and transform test text with that vocabulary. The scratch multinomial classifier uses alpha=1.0 and predicts the transformed test rows.
You print accuracy, a confusion matrix, and a classification report. The recording reports accuracy 0.667 with four correct predictions among six texts.

steps.question: Which sign of log_odds favors spam in this calculation?
steps.answer: Positive values favor spam because the score subtracts log P(word given ham) from log P(word given spam). The spam list sorts scores in descending order.

steps.description: You map feature indices back to words and print both ranked lists. The recording puts act and now at 0.862 for spam and at at -1.623 for ham.
